summary.text: Paul Nix is a Republican running for Indiana House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Democrat Victoria Garcia Wilburn.
An insurance agency owner, he previously sought the Republican nomination for the seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Paul Nix was born in Fort Wayne, Indiana, and his career experience includes working as an insurance agency owner.
In the May 3, 2022 Republican primary for District 32, Nix received 479 votes (11.5%), behind Fred Glynn and Suzie Jaworowski.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had been in the insurance business for 44 years and described himself as a conservative.
He named faith, family and freedom as his key messages and listed fiscal responsibility and protecting the unborn among his policy interests.
